title: Fabricated subject is refused despite surviving sources
fabrication_note: "Veltrix Pay" is an invented company/product with no real-world referent. It exists only for this test. The surrounding terms (agentic commerce, settlement network) are real, so the search returns genuine payments articles that are topic-adjacent but not about the fabricated entity.

input.topic: Veltrix Pay agentic commerce settlement network

objective: A plausible-sounding but invented subject must not produce a brief, even when retrieval returns enough topic-adjacent material to clear the numeric source-count threshold.
why_it_matters: A refusal on a topic that returns no sources is trivial. Here eight candidates were dropped at triage but three plausible sources survived - enough to satisfy had_enough_evidence and source_count >= 3 - and the model still recognised that none substantiate the fabricated company, returning INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE rather than assembling a brief around adjacent material. This is the failure mode that separates a grounded system from a summariser.
